To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of the thermally reduced graphene oxide supercapacitor is significantly enhanced by increasing the interlayer distance through ionic interaction.
the interlayer distance can be effectively tuned by the ionic interaction of the CTAB/ILs.
the intercalated ILs can be effectively utilized to enlarge the interlayer spacing of the TRG composites, and the performance of the resulting EDLCs was significantly improved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interlayer distance effect on the performance of TRG based EDLCs.
the influence of the interlayer distance on the electrochemical performance of the EDLCSs.
the effect of the interlayer distance on the performance of the TRG based EDLCs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interlayer distance plays a key role in the performance of EDLC cells, especially for the energy density.
by enlarging the interlayer spacing of the TRG through ionic interaction, the performance of EDLCs could be improved.
the ionic surfactant CTAB was successfully employed to prevent the stacking of the TRG layers and the ILs were intercalated in between the TRG layers to further enlarge the interlayer space.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a facile method was demonstrated to effectively increase the interlayer distance in TRG sheets by the intercalation of ionic species, which can be used as an alternative approach to improve the performance of EDLCs.
the ionic interaction is a facile approach to effectively tune the performance of TRG-based supercapacitors.
a simple approach can be developed to effectively enlarge the accessible surface area of the TRG composites through the ionic interactions between the intercalating species and IL electrolyte.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the intercalated surfactant can effectively enlarge the inter-layer distance of TRG and enhance the energy density of EDLCs based on the composites.
the performance of TRG based supercapacitors could be improved by increasing the interlayer distance through the introduction of ionic species.
the interlayer distance can be tuned by the intercalated cationic surfacant and ionic species, and this can be a promising approach to improve the performance of EDLC cells.
